claims: Clean the charging contacts on the earbud and inside the case using a cotton swab and a little rubbing alcohol.
Ensure the charging case is sufficiently charged by plugging it into a working power source.
Check for any debris or dirt obstructing the charging port of the case.
Reset the earbuds according to the manufacturer instructions if cleaning does not work.

claims.text: Clean the gold pins on the earbuds and in the case with isopropyl alcohol on a swab.
Brush the speaker mesh gently with a dry toothbrush.
Put both earbuds in the case and charge it from a wall socket for about 2 hours.
